text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.S. envoy's Middle East mission is failing - editorial.
- Vice-President Ramadan meets Chinese women's delegation.
- Japanese society donates medical supplies to Iraq.
(The above except for the editorial were also carried by IRAQ and QADISSIYA)
- Group of Iraqi businessmen to head for Syria on Friday.
- Turkish company says it will buy 2.8 million tonnes of crude oil from Iraq.
- Iraq's ruling Baath party delegation continues meetings with political parties in India.
